name: QR Code generator library (TypeScript, compilado para JavaScript)

build.opcoes: --strict --lib DOM,DOM.Iterable,ES6 --target ES6 (as de typescript-javascript/build.sh do projeto; o resto é o padrão do tsc, inclusive newline LF)
passos: sha256sum qrcodegen.ts   # tem de dar o source_sha256 deste manifesto
npx --yes -p typescript@5.6.3 tsc --strict --lib DOM,DOM.Iterable,ES6 --target ES6 --outDir saida qrcodegen.ts
sha256sum saida/qrcodegen.js   # tem de dar files["qrcodegen.js"] deste manifesto
build.comando: npx --yes -p typescript@5.6.3 tsc --strict --lib DOM,DOM.Iterable,ES6 --target ES6 --outDir saida qrcodegen.ts
